title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification
abstract: arXiv:2609.36560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object re-identification (ReID) faces a recurring challenge: different identities can share highly similar global appearances, while the cues that distinguish them are localized, heterogeneous, and visible only under particular viewpoints. This challenge arises in animal ReID through markings, contours, and scars, in person ReID through subtle clothing and accessory cues, and in vehicle ReID through localized appearance details. Although visual foundation models encode such information in dense tokens, a single holistic descriptor can obscure discriminative local signals. We propose FM-ReID, an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing. Its Competitive Fine-grained Mining module uses multiple mining queries and a residual query to compete for dense DINOv3 tokens. translated_title: FM-ReID：用于目标重识别的选择性竞争令牌路由
translated_abstract: 目标重识别（ReID）面临一个反复出现的挑战：不同身份可能拥有高度相似的全局外观，而区分它们的线索是局部的、异构的，并且仅在特定视角下可见。这一挑战在动物重识别中体现为斑纹、轮廓和疤痕，在行人重识别中体现为细微的衣着和配饰线索，在车辆重识别中体现为局部外观细节。尽管视觉基础模型已在密集令牌中编码了这些信息，但单一的整体描述符可能会掩盖具有判别力的局部信号。我们提出FM-ReID，这是一个端到端框架，将局部表示学习表述为选择性竞争令牌路由。其竞争性细粒度挖掘模块使用多个挖掘查询和一个残差查询来竞争密集的DINOv3令牌。高于先验的筛选机制保留优先分配给每个挖掘查询的令牌，而残差槽则（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出FM-ReID端到端框架，将局部表示学习建模为选择性竞争令牌路由，利用竞争性细粒度挖掘模块从DINOv3密集令牌中提取局部判别线索，解决不同身份全局外观高度相似的目标重识别难题。
en_tdlr: FM-ReID is an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing, using a Competitive Fine-grained Mining module to extract discriminative local cues from dense DINOv3 tokens for object re-identification.
